knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure says to operate only within training and equipment rating, to route leads away from doors and walkways, and to keep liquids away from unrated equipment.
The worked scenario pauses when a scrubber approaches an occupied corridor, places barriers and arranges an alternative route. The procedure says to isolate energy before clearing blockages.
The core procedure says to stop and isolate energy before changing accessories or clearing blockages, as the manufacturer directs.

practicalCriteria: Uses controls, maintains safe separation and shuts down without exposing bystanders.
Explains applicable scope and site procedures
Demonstrates hazard controls and safe stop-work decisions
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 2: Route leads away from doors and walkways, with suitable electrical protection, and keep liquids away from unrated equipment.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 4 is not done: If the method, product or equipment is unsafe or uncertain, pause, protect the area and seek supervisor guidance before continuing.
Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Stop and isolate energy before changing accessories or clearing blockages, as the manufacturer directs.
